incident_text: WhatsApp replies are arriving late for many users, and some never arrive. Started around 09:00.

E-001.claim: msg-delivery deploy with a batch size increase landed at 08:49, just before the memory climb
E-001.excerpt: batch size increase for delivery receipts
E-001.author: reasoning

E-002.claim: msg-delivery memory pressure began right after the deploy and climbed steadily
E-002.excerpt: 2026-04-01T08:50:15Z WARN msg-delivery: memory usage 59% of limit, gc pressure high
E-002.author: reasoning

E-003.claim: msg-delivery workers began being OOM-killed at 09:05
E-003.excerpt: 2026-04-01T09:05:39Z ERROR msg-delivery: worker killed: out of memory, restarting consumer
E-003.author: reasoning

E-004.claim: Messages were redelivered on outbound-msgs after the kills
E-004.excerpt: 2026-04-01T09:05:59Z WARN msg-delivery: redelivered 7 messages on outbound-msgs
E-004.author: reasoning

E-005.claim: outbound-msgs consumers dropped from 4 to 2 and stayed there
E-005.author: reasoning

E-006.claim: outbound-msgs depth started rising at 08:55, before the consumer count dropped, then grew steadily
E-006.author: reasoning

E-007.claim: msg-delivery memory peaked at the 99% limit and workers restarted up to 5 times in 5 minutes
E-007.author: reasoning

E-008.claim: The inbound queue is healthy, so the problem is not upstream of the outbound queue
E-008.author: reasoning

E-009.claim: msg-delivery consumes only from outbound-msgs, so its failure directly backs up that queue
E-009.author: reasoning

E-010.claim: The larger batch size in msg-delivery-00277 probably causes the memory growth, for example by holding more receipts in memory per batch. This is inferred from timing only.
E-010.author: reasoning

H1.statement: msg-delivery is OOM-killed with a memory leak or oversized batches, likely introduced by deploy msg-delivery-00277. Consumer capacity on outbound-msgs halves and the backlog grows, so replies are delayed.

H2.statement: The backlog comes from upstream load or another service (orchestrator or inbound path) rather than from msg-delivery.

notes: Whether the batch size change in msg-delivery-00277 is the actual cause of the memory growth. The evidence is timing only, and a rollback would test it.
The msg-delivery logs were truncated at 09:08. Later behaviour and any other error types were not reviewed.
Why some replies never arrive. The DLQ is 0, so loss may come from OOM kills mid-processing or from expiry, and this was not verified.
Config changes and WhatsApp-side delivery receipts were not examined. Orchestrator, llm-gateway and the other services were not checked individually.
